setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays a four-step phrase on steps 1-4 (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65 at velocities 127, 117, 107, 97) through a MIDI device on OUT 1, in C major at 90 BPM with sixteenth-note steps (Rate /1). The Channel editor is open and the Pattern editor has not been opened. On Pattern Note the range buttons on row 8 are range-up (14,8), centre (15,8) and range-down (16,8). A press moves the window one degree up or down, a long press jumps to the top or bottom, and the centre button returns to the root page. Pattern Velocity has only two range buttons, (15,8) toward the top page and (16,8) toward the lower page, as the next lesson shows.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press Pattern (5,8) twice to open Pattern Note for pattern 1. The seven rows are scale degrees, with the root on the bottom row. Tap (4,1), the top row of step 4's column. Press Play at (1,8), then Stop: step 4 now plays degree 6, MIDI 71, while steps 1-3 stay 60, 62, 64.
steps.title: Choose a scale degree

steps.caption: Tap range-up (14,8), then tap (4,1): step 4 is now MIDI 72, the next C. Play to check, then Stop. Tap range-up once more, then tap (4,1): step 4 is MIDI 74. Play to check, then Stop.
steps.title: Move the range up twice

steps.caption: Tap range-down (16,8): the window moves down one degree. Tap (4,1): step 4 is MIDI 72 again. Play, then Stop. Tap range-down once more, then tap (4,1): step 4 is back to MIDI 71. Play, then Stop.
steps.title: Move the range down twice

steps.caption: Hold range-up (14,8) for about a second: the window jumps to its highest position. Tap (4,1): step 4 plays MIDI 83. Tap range-up again: the window cannot go higher, so (4,1) still plays MIDI 83.
steps.title: Jump to the top, which is a limit

steps.caption: Hold range-down (16,8) for about a second: the window jumps to its lowest position. Tap (4,7), the bottom row: step 4 plays MIDI 48. Tap range-down again: the window cannot go lower, so (4,7) still plays MIDI 48.
steps.title: Jump to the bottom, which is a limit

steps.caption: Tap the centre button at (15,8): the window returns to the root page, with the root on the bottom row. Tap (4,4), degree 3: step 4 plays MIDI 65 and the original phrase 60, 62, 64, 65 is back.
steps.title: Return to the central range
